ModifyGlobalSecurityIPGroupName.description_zh: 修改全局IP白名单模板的名称

ModifyGlobalSecurityIPGroupRelation.description_en: Adds a specified instance to a specified IP whitelist template
ModifyGlobalSecurityIPGroupRelation.description_zh: 将指定实例添加到指定的IP白名单模板中

ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies partial information of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance, such as the instance password and name
ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的部分信息，包括实例密码、名称等

ModifyInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute.description_en: Enables or disables the auto-renewal feature for ApsaraDB Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instances
ModifyInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute.description_zh: 开启或者关闭云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的到期前自动续费功能

ModifyInstanceBandwidth.description_en: Configures the target bandwidth settings for an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
ModifyInstanceBandwidth.description_zh: 设置云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的目标带宽值

ModifyInstanceConfig.description_en: Modifies the parameter settings of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
ModifyInstanceConfig.description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的参数配置

ModifyInstanceMaintainTime.description_en: Modifies the maintenance window of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance. Alibaba Cloud performs routine maintenance on the instance within the specified maintenance window
ModifyInstanceMaintainTime.description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的可维护时段，阿里云将在您设定的可维护时段内对实例进行例行维护

ModifyInstanceMajorVersion.description_en: Upgrades the major engine version of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
ModifyInstanceMajorVersion.description_zh: 升级云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的大版本

ModifyInstanceMinorVersion.description_en: Upgrades the minor version of an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
ModifyInstanceMinorVersion.description_zh: 升级云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的小版本

ModifyInstanceNetExpireTime.description_en: Extends the retention period of the classic network endpoint for a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance that retains the classic network endpoint after a switch from the classic network to a VPC
ModifyInstanceNetExpireTime.description_zh: 若云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例之前执行过由经典网络向VPC网络切换，并保留了经典网络连接地址，则可调用本接口延长经典网络连接地址的保留时间

ModifyInstanceParameter.description_en: Applies a parameter template to a specified instance to assign the parameter values in the template to the instance. If you modify a parameter template, you must reapply it to the instance for the modified parameter values to take effect
ModifyInstanceParameter.description_zh: 将参数模板应用至指定实例，表示将参数模板的值赋于指定的实例中。当您修改参数模版后，您也需要重新应用至指定实例，才能将修改后的参数值赋于指定实例

ModifyInstanceSSL.description_en: Enables the Transport Layer Security (TLS) encryption protocol for an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
ModifyInstanceSSL.description_zh: 为云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例开启TLS（Transport Layer Security）加密协议配置

ModifyInstanceSpec.description_en: Modifies the specifications of an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) instance
ModifyInstanceSpec.description_zh: 变更云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的规格

ModifyInstanceTDE.description_en: Enables the Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) feature for an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) database instance and supports custom keys
ModifyInstanceTDE.description_zh: 为云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例开启透明数据加密TDE功能，支持自定义密钥

ModifyInstanceVpcAuthMode.description_en: Enables or initiates a shutdown of password-free access over a VPC. After this feature is enabled, cloud servers in the same VPC can connect to the ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance without a password. Connections using a username and password are still supported
ModifyInstanceVpcAuthMode.description_zh: 开启或关闭专有网络免密访问。开启后，同一专有网络内的云服务器无需使用密码即可连接云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例，同时也继续兼容通过用户名和密码的方式连接实例

ModifyIntranetAttribute.description_en: Temporarily adjusts the internal network bandwidth of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance in a dedicated cluster
ModifyIntranetAttribute.description_zh: 临时调整专属集群中云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的内网带宽

ModifyParameterGroup.description_en: Modifies the settings of a parameter template

ModifyResourceGroup.description_en: Modifies the resource group of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) database instance
ModifyResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例所属的资源组

ModifySecurityGroupConfiguration.description_en: Configures the security group settings in the whitelist of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
ModifySecurityGroupConfiguration.description_zh: 设置云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例白名单中的安全组

ModifySecurityIps.description_en: Configures the IP whitelist of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
ModifySecurityIps.description_zh: 设置云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的IP白名单

ModifyTaskInfo.description_en: Performs operations on tasks. Currently, only modifying the task execution time is supported
ModifyTaskInfo.description_zh: 进行任务操作，当前支持修改任务执行时间点

RebootProxy.description_en: Restarts the proxy nodes of a running Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
RebootProxy.description_zh: 重启运行中的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的代理节点

ReleaseDirectConnection.description_en: Releases the direct connection endpoint of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database cluster instance
ReleaseDirectConnection.description_zh: 释放云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群实例的直连地址

ReleaseInstancePublicConnection.description_en: Releases the public endpoint of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
ReleaseInstancePublicConnection.description_zh: 释放云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的公网连接地址

RemoveSubInstance.description_en: Removes a child instance from a distributed instance and converts it into a regular instance while retaining the data
RemoveSubInstance.description_zh: 将子实例从分布式实例中移除并转变为普通实例（数据会被保留）

RenewAdditionalBandwidth.description_en: Renews the bandwidth of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance. This operation is deprecated because the bandwidth billing method has been upgraded to the pay-as-you-go pattern
RenewAdditionalBandwidth.description_zh: 云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的带宽已升级为按量付费模式，不再推荐使用本接口

RenewInstance.description_en: Creates a renewal order for a subscription ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) instance
RenewInstance.description_zh: 为包年包月的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例续费

ResetAccountPassword.description_en: Resets the password of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database account
ResetAccountPassword.description_zh: 重置云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）账号的密码

RestartInstance.description_en: Restarts a running Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
RestartInstance.description_zh: 重启运行中的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例

RestoreInstance.description_en: Restores data from a specified backup file to a Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) database instance
RestoreInstance.description_zh: 恢复指定备份文件中的数据到云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例中

SwitchInstanceHA.description_en: Performs a primary/secondary switchover to switch node roles. This operation is applicable to scenarios such as disaster recovery drills and nearest access for applications in multi-zone deployments
SwitchInstanceHA.description_zh: 执行主备切换（即切换节点角色），可应用于容灾演练、多可用区场景下的应用就近连接等需求

SwitchInstanceProxy.description_en: Starts or performs a shutdown of the proxy pattern for an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database cluster instance in a dedicated cluster
SwitchInstanceProxy.description_zh: 开启或关闭专属集群中云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群实例的代理模式

SwitchInstanceToTargetZone.description_en: Switches an instance to a specified target zone
SwitchInstanceToTargetZone.description_zh: 实例指定目标可用区切换

SwitchInstanceZoneFailOver.description_en: Performs an impersonation of a zone-level failure of an active ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) cluster architecture database instance, triggering an automatic switchover to the secondary zone
SwitchInstanceZoneFailOver.description_zh: 模拟云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群架构实例发生可用区级别故障，实例将自动切换到备可用区中

SwitchNetwork.description_en: Switches the VPC or vSwitch of an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) database instance. If the instance is in the classic network, it is switched to a VPC
SwitchNetwork.description_zh: 切换云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的专有网络VPC或交换机，如果实例为经典网络，则会将其切换为专有网络

SyncDtsStatus.description_en: Before you use Data Transmission Service (DTS) to migrate or synchronize data of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) database instance, you can invoke this operation to restrict the instance so that it does not execute Upgrade/Downgrade operations. This prevents data migration or synchronization nodes from becoming failed due to Upgrade/Downgrade
SyncDtsStatus.description_zh: 在使用DTS迁移或同步云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的数据前，您可以调用本接口限制该实例执行变配操作，避免因变配引起的数据迁移或同步任务失败

TagResources.description_en: Attaches labels to one or more ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instances
TagResources.description_zh: 为一个或多个云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例绑定标签

TransformInstanceChargeType.description_en: Transforms the billing method of an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) database instance between pay-as-you-go and subscription
TransformInstanceChargeType.description_zh: 转换云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的付费类型，支持按量付费和包年包月付费类型之间的相互转换

TransformToEcs.description_en: Converts a local disk instance to a cloud-native instance

TransformToPrePaid.description_en: Transforms a pay-as-you-go Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance into a subscription instance
TransformToPrePaid.description_zh: 将按量付费的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例转换为包年包月（预付费）实例

UnlockDBInstanceWrite.description_en: Unlocks a write-locked instance. After the instance is unlocked, it supports data read and write operations
UnlockDBInstanceWrite.description_zh: 对写锁定的实例进行解锁，解锁后，实例支持读取、写入数据

UntagResources.description_en: Removes labels from an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) database instance
UntagResources.description_zh: 将标签从云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例解绑

UpgradeProxy.description_en: Upgrades the proxy node of a cluster instance to the latest version
UpgradeProxy.description_zh: 升级集群版实例代理节点 proxy 到最新的版本

endpoints.region_name_zh: 华东6（福州-本地地域）已关停
华东5（南京-本地地域）已关停
华北6（乌兰察布）通用行业云
